question: Should ClawHub/OpenClaw continue supporting the legacy `molt.bot` curl-piped installer, or should that path be retired or redirected to current install commands?
rationale: The failure is in a hosted legacy script absent from current main, so automation cannot safely choose between patching external installer behavior and moving users away from it.

options.title: Retire or redirect legacy installer
options.body: Point `molt.bot` users to the maintained OpenClaw and ClawHub install commands and document the supported Node range.

options.title: Support and track the installer
options.body: Bring the hosted installer source under version control and harden the zsh cleanup glob for unmatched Homebrew npm paths.

options.title: Wait for fresh reporter data
options.body: Keep the issue waiting for a current reproduction before choosing the legacy support boundary.

recommendation.title: Retire or redirect legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point `molt.bot` users to the maintained OpenClaw and ClawHub install commands and document the supported Node range.

likelyOwner.reason: The current maintained CLI/package install surfaces and docs blame to Patrick-Erichsen through a230d962/PR 2932.
